title: kissed bitter slovakian danmuji hash
description: a diabetic-friendly, crunchy danmuji hash made with sous-vide egg and monsoon spices, inspired by slovakian cuisine

ingredients.name: monsoon spices
ingredients.notes: blend of cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and paprika

instructions: preheat the sous-vide water bath to 160f
season the ground beef with salt and black pepper
cook the ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks
add the monsoon spices to the pan and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly
add the danmuji to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it begins to brown
crack the sous-vide eggs into a bowl and stir gently to break up the yolks
pour the egg mixture over the danmuji and beef mixture in the pan
cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are cooked to desired doneness
stir in the chopped cilantro and sour cream
serve the danmuji hash hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired
